reviews.title: Great product for the money
reviews.comment: I installed this aio in a new to me build. Once I got the bios settings sorted for the pump it holds a temp great. I'm sure the more expensive models are better but since my rig is not overlooked it works great. But for the cost a reliable aio for 35 bucks you simply cannot go wrong.
